approach.text: A cloaked figure lurks in the shadows. He eyes you up and down, then pulls back his cloak to reveal a collection of blades strapped to his chest. "Psst. You look like someone who could use a little... insurance. Poisoned Dagger, freshly coated. Fifteen gold."

bought.text: He slides the dagger across with a grin missing several teeth. "Pleasure doing business. Don't miss."
